## 31e0316dace3

**A31-PROFILE-HARD — Reproduced distribution coverage defect.** The default
hard sampler has no support for either canonical `(height, width, palette-size)`
profile, `(8, 8, 4)` or `(10, 10, 4)`. The packet's supported after-phase
`profile_floor` stage fails with exit 1 because hard has 0 exact-profile hits
in 20 draws. This is a coverage failure under the current per-band floor;
it is not evidence that the quadrant-summary Racket rule gives incorrect answers.

The audit target is unchanged at generator SHA-256
`5ce4b3ee4184f1e49633dfd79ea08c5c5bf4844fc680c53b3da7d059767faf97`.
The selected canonical rule has normalized hash `00eaf58ae429` and raw source
SHA-256 `00eaf58ae4296c6ca1b0a298b9f8d54b2df5281c71d9c03ca6683576b8d19b94`.
The report also pins the shared `GenCtx` source and the reusable audit script.
The apply report's separate `rule_text_sha256` field hashes the wrapped
callable; it is not the canonical source hash. A corrected audit-harness
assertion that initially confused those two fields is retained in
`checks/audit/31e0316dace3/finish_assertion_failure.json` (exit 1); it was not a
target rule failure.

### Evidence and cause

The target's `generate` function draws both half-dimensions with
`ctx.draw_int_diff(..., 3, 7)` and doubles them. The current shared helper maps
`difficulty="hard"` to `d` in `[0.66, 1]`, then computes `round(3 + 4*d)`.
Consequently each half-dimension is 6 or 7, so the full dimensions are 12 or 14.
This proves the default hard sampler cannot reach either canonical size under
the audited source; it is not merely an unlucky 20-draw sample.

The independent census uses the exact profile gate's pinned seed policy:
for each band and census index `i=0..19`,
`seed=int(sha256(f"profile-floor:v1:31e0316dace3:{band}:{i}").hexdigest()[:12],16)`
and `sample_index=seed % 7919 + i`. All numeric seeds and sample indices are
retained in [generation.json](checks/audit/31e0316dace3/generation.json).
Every draw calls the actual target `generate` with no overrides. These are
60 individual draws, not overlapping lesson windows.

| Band | Exact canonical-profile hits | Unique inputs | Validator/domain rejections |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| easy | 8/20 | 20/20 | 0/20 |
| medium | 5/20 | 20/20 | 0/20 |
| hard | 0/20 | 20/20 | 0/20 |

The supported stage independently reports the same counts and pooled support
of 13/60. Its failure, source-bound receipt and exact command journal remain in
[profile_floor](checks/audit/31e0316dace3/profile_floor/).

### Actual execution and lawful witness

The supported `arcpuzzles apply` command executes all 60 census grids, all three
canonical pairs, and one explicit hard override witness: 64/64 valid Racket
outputs, 64/64 matching the documented quadrant-color output, and 3/3 matching
canonical outputs. All 64 inputs pass `self_check` and an independent check of
the documented dimensions, palette, single-color quadrants, cell counts,
distinct quadrant colors and empty-quadrant limit.

The witness at input index 63 uses seed `31415926`, sample index `0`, hard band,
and overrides `half_h=4`, `half_w=4`, `empty_quadrant="top_right"`. It is a lawful
8x8 grid with palette-size 4 and actual Racket output `[[4,0],[9,5]]`.
[counterexample.json](checks/audit/31e0316dace3/counterexample.json) retains that
grid, its output, hashes, parameters, validator/domain status and exact command.
It demonstrates that the canonical profile is allowed and reachable through
the control surface while excluded by the default hard sampler. No rival
solver or rival-output mismatch is claimed for this distribution finding.

### Scope and reproduction

The reusable script is
`repo/generators/53ffc8bc9584/workspace/audit_31e0316dace3.py`.
[audit.json](checks/audit/31e0316dace3/audit.json) records exact argument arrays,
working directories, exit codes, hashes and evidence paths. Commands run from
`packet_root`; the import-only probe uses the actual portable runtime directory
`repo/shared/runtime`. Racket outputs and their recorded execution command are
in [racket.json](checks/audit/31e0316dace3/racket.json).

This is a findings-only audit. The target generator and all rule authorities
were left unchanged. No full battery, lesson rival census, universal induction
claim or training approval is made. The generated examples are valid; the
remaining failure is specifically missing canonical profile support in the
default hard band under the current after-phase requirement.

triage.reason: Findings-only notes retained for later assignments, as reviewer-reported leads; audited source not altered during this acceptance.
